batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b MM Sharma

batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b BW Hilfenhaus

batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b MM Sharma

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b MM Sharma

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c CJ Anderson b PP Ojha

batting.dismissal: st CM Gautam b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: st CM Gautam b Harbhajan Singh

balls.text: misses this full one outside off and they sneak in a bye
94.3 kph, slower and slower from Hilfenhaus, he swings the shortish ball over deep midwicket

Raina races in from extra cover, dives forward, takes the ball but immediately shakes his head, and raises his hands saying he is not sure it carried, replays show it bounced just before he took it, MI avoid losing another wicket to a mishit off a slower ball
yorker on middle, Zaheer is backing away and drags it to deep midwicket
now walks outside off and swings this length ball over square leg, there is a man in the deep there
Gautam reverse-sweeps this full ball going across him past short third man
they cannot do anything with these slower ones, Harbhajan tries to cut this length ball over point, finds the man with a palpably mistimed shot
now a 141.5 kph yorker outside off to the new batsman, what a bowling display from CSK, Harbhajan misses
slower and lethal from CSK continues, 103 kph back-of-the-hand length ball just outside off, Pollard slogs, only gets a thin inside edge that hits off
moves across to this good length ball but can only work it close to the pitch on leg
107.9 kph, slow and full, he cannot get under it and drags it to deep midwicket
another slower one produces another wicket, 105 kph length ball outside off from Mohit, Rayudu slogs it to Raina at long on, who moves to his left to take it
backs away to leg and swings an overpitched ball to long on
139 kph bouncer from round the stumps, he hasn't got hold of the hook and it loops to square leg
very slow short ball at only 97.5 kph, Rohit has to try and create his own momentum on the pull, but only manages to drag it tamely to deep midwicket
angled full across him, he drives off a thick edge to the sweeper
sends in a 137 kph yorker on middle and leg, Rohit squeezes it down the ground and reaches a fifty in his 100th IPL match
a slower length ball on the pad, turned to short fine leg
drives an overpitched widish one straight to short extra cover
swung hard down to Raina at long on
that is one bounce into the MI dugout at fine leg, he bends forward to a full delivery on the stumps and lifts it high in that region
Pandey gets in the yorker, it's dug out to the off side
opens the face and runs this back of a length ball towards point
a low full toss outside off, Pollard swings and misses
ends the over with yet another slower one, and it is only nudged on the leg side for one
cannot get another slower length away, taps it to point
back of a length, turned behind square leg
Rohit's missed out here, this was a wide length ball, third man was up, but his weak dab has found the fielder
direct hit from Ashwin at extra cover gets Anderson, he drilled this full delivery straight to the fielder and went for the single, replays show he is inches short
a slower one wide outside off, he underedges an attempted cut to third man
could have been another one, bouncing outside off stump, Rohit cuts it on the bounce to short third man
too wide, Rohit waits and places the cut just past backward point, bounces in front of the fielder even as he dives and rushes past
drives the full one with the spin through extra cover, and comes back for the second as sweeper runs around
widish length ball at 96 kph, Anderson pummels it off the back foot to long off
hammered, picks it from wide outside off stump and slogs it into the straight boundary, past long on's dive
backs away to one outside off and cuts it over point
has a go at this 99 kph full delivery but drags it off the inner part of the bat to long on
punched off the back foot to long off
Anderson wants the second after working this through midwicket, but the fielder from the deep runs in to keep them to one
pitches leg and spins in slightly, is worked square
leans forward and pushes the full delivery to extra cover
dropped, Anderson skips out and smashes straight to Raina, who goes down on the ground as the missile hits his fingers and flies at the umpire
punched off the back foot to wide long off
drops it short and Rohit slogs it hard over deep square leg
Rohit comes down the track and uses the pace on this shortish one to time the cut behind point
backs away to a pitched up 98.2 kph ball and cracks it to the off side, McCullum goes racing across to his left and half-stops it, then gets up to stop it and throw it at the non-striker's
quick and flat, Rohit pulls, does not get hold of it, but beats midwicket's dive
good length ball on middle at 97.2 kph, turned square to leg
angled full across the right-hander, who drives it to extra cover
goes back to a 96 kph length ball and knocks it to long on
works a fuller one past the bowler to long on
flatter length ball turned in front of square leg, fielder comes in quickly and Rohit has to get back
bowled full on off stump, he stretches forward and pushes it to long off
punched to the sweeper for a single
slower one almost works, Anderson swings hard and skies it , three men converge on it at midwicket but it eludes them all
short of a length, guided to backward point, who has a go at the striker's end and misses
just back of a length, it hurries on even as he drags it down to long on
back of a length outside off at 135.7 kph, calmly dabbed to third man
nicely done, Rohit moves across to a full delivery and flicks it high over midwicket, it crashes right into the rope
Anderson finishes the over with a skip down the track and muscles the ball high over long off
slight spin from outside off, punched hard to long off
knocked down to long off
walks out and pushes past extra cover's dive to wide long off
straightish on middle and off, pushed back
length ball darted in to the pad, worked in front of square
Rohit now has a swing and a miss outside off, excellent over from Ishwar Pandey
late inswing again, takes this through midwicket, Anderson was looking for that big off drive again
in the blockhole at 135.2, swings in late to beat his attempted big drive, wasn't far from off stump too
holds its line outside off and climbs from back of a length, is guided to third man
drags a short of a length ball down to long on
a length ball angled across the left-hander, who attacks it only to be beaten
turned to midwicket
takes a couple of steps out, Raina drags it short, and Anderson pulls it just over midwicket's jump
driven to extra cover
very full delivery knocked down to long on
nudged off the the pad to the right of Ashwin at short fine leg
length ball on off, forced back to the bowler
they get something from the over, this is fuller outside off, Rohit bends and is able to scoop it to the fine leg boundary
a slower ball on off, but they've done well with this, nudged it in front of square leg, Dhoni goes after it, and they have time to come back for the second
this comes in a bit now from just back of a length, Rohit dabs it to backward point
looks to punch this length ball through the covers but cannot time it at all
hits that good length again just outside off, punched to mid off
gets forward to a length ball but backward point comes in to prevent any chance of a single
comes forward and nudges to midwicket
reaches forward and drives on the bounce to extra cover
straightening on middle, he goes back and punches to mid on
quicker and angled in to the pad, Anderson manages to get some bat on it, and it races fine down the leg side
good length ball worked off the pad to square leg
tossed up full on middle and off, he presses forward to push it down the track
allows a length ball to come on outside off, and softly runs it to backward point for one
comes forward to a pitched up ball and pushes to mid on
but he's gone now, he's tried to force a length ball over mid-on, but mishit it, and the fielder has plenty of time to take the dolly
he looks in excellent touch, punches a length ball off the back foot, it flies to cover
sees some width on this back of a length ball and goes hard at it, but misses
walks out to a back of a length ball and has a swipe, thick under edge goes to short fine leg
comes out and chips it down to long on
punched off the back foot, McCullum at extra cover stops it
flat delivery straightens outside off and is cut, but he hasn't timed it well this time
length ball angled into the pad, Anderson opens up and turns it in front of square on leg
again he times it well, full delivery angled across from round the stumps, he reverse sweeps but finds short third man
tossed up fullish one leg, worked straight to midwicket
how close was that length ball to off stump as it straightened, quite brave leave from Anderson
short of a length into the body, nudged on the leg side for one
attacks a shortish and wide one, is beaten
this is pitched up now, but still enough room outside off, Tare times the drive through cover, reaching out a bit to adjust for the swing
more width this time, 135 kph, back of a length, Tare crashes it through extra cover
beaten, sharp swing away from the right-hander, he follows the back of a length ball from the crease, and misses it
superb delivery hits top of off, good length, pitches around middle, Hussey looks to defend from the crease, the ball seams away past the outside edge to hit the stumps
Hussey tries to pull a length ball again, probably expecting it to swing in, but it moves away a tad to beat him outside off
on the pad now and worked through square leg
and again, he picks the same gap, short of a length ball, hops to get on top of the bounce and punches it sweetly through point
length ball pushed back

that is very well placed, Hilfenhaus swings this length ball away at 138 kph, Tare follows it and opens the face to guide it between cover-point and backward point, it was in the air but just wide of a diving Raina
good line, good length ball ending on middle, Hussey defends it to short extra cover
wants to pull this 134.6 kph delivery, it is not short enough and Hussey is beaten outside off
just outside off to the left-hander now, he moves forward and pushes it away
holds the line on a good length, and is punched solidly, but Raina at cover dives to his right and keeps them to one
Hussey has to dive early, he worked a back of a length ball square on the leg side and set off, direct hit would have been tight
good length ball straightening on the pad, he times it well but finds square leg
McCullum brings CSK home as he swipes this wide of deep midwicket
pulls a short ball to fine leg
drives an overpitched ball to long on
forced down to long on for one more
Anderson sends this length ball down the pads, and Dhoni does not miss out
cuts a widish one to sweeper cover
low full toss eased to long on
around the blockhole, he digs it out to midwicket
needed a dive at sweeper cover, but not only is Zaheer slow in running across, he also does not dive to concede a boundary, McCullum flayed it with an open face over extra cover
full again, hit down the ground to long on
Dhoni goes deep in the crease to a full delivery and helicopters it over deep midwicket
knocks a full delivery to the bowler, who parries it to the leg side, they don't get the single, but Malinga has overstepped, tight call by umpire Bowden
McCullum had given up, Dhoni whipped a full one to midwicket, Hussey picked it up and released it quickly, McCullum was way out of his ground, but Hussey missed
Dhoni gets bat to ball this time to turn this length ball to midwicket
worked off the pad to deep square leg
he's hit on the pad again as he comes out to this length ball
appeal for leg before as Dhoni misses the nudge to leg, but there is too much angle, there is a direct hit too, but McCullum is home, they take another for the ricochet
shuffles to outside off, pushes a length ball to Zaheer
drives a full one to long off
Faf is gone this time, he lunges out and misses a flighted ball, keeper does not, Harbhajan is pumped up
another chance, but a very difficult one, McCullum lofts in the direction of long off, who runs in some way, dives forward, but does not make it, falls just short
another slog-sweep, falls short of deep midwicket this time
turned through midwicket along the ground, McCullum has to dive back on the second, throw misses
Pollard drops a sitter, du Plessis skied this slog-sweep to a tossed up delivery, Pollard ran in from deep midwicket and clanged it
charges out to a full delivery and flashes it to the sweeper
gets some bat on the drive for a single wide of cover
now McCullum is beaten on the drive with a sharp and full outswinger just outside off
drags a full delivery from off to long on
skips out to this full toss but is beaten by the slight away shape, which also takes it just past off
chops this back of a length ball to point
flashes a drive at a full away swinging delivery, sweeper cover fields
length ball swiped behind square on the leg side with the angle
goes outside off and gets too close to the line of this length ball to be able to time his shot, hits it to extra cover
length ball into leg stump, McCullum makes room and squeezes it to point
tries to pull this slow and wide but is beaten
he's waiting to use the angle into him this time, not too short, but he gets under it and swings it high, and comfortably clear of deep square leg
charges out and has a heave, misses the delivery which bounces just over the stumps
fine drive through extra cover, long off is around but McCullum races back for the second
another slower one, it bounces and hits the bat high as McCullum drops it into the off side to reach his fifty with a single
turns this slow length ball from around off to short fine
overpitched ball driven to long off
delivers a high full toss into the right hander, and McCullum whips it inches inside the deep square leg rope
moves across to a full one and works it to deep square leg
makes some room to squeeze this quick and low full toss wide of the sweeper
charges out, Harbhajan bowls it shorter, but McCullum goes through with the shot with all his momentum and hammers it over the bowler
makes more room and scythes a full toss to short third man, McCullum is quick and makes it across
down the track to a flighted one, cannot work it past midwicket
goes back to a fuller one and punches to extra cover
makes room outside leg, Harbhajan follows him, he knocks it to midwicket
driven down the ground for a single

McCullum drives a full delivery, Tare does well to go sprawling to his left at mid off, McCullum wants a second, he is well out of his crease but Tare has already thrown it to the striker's end, and McCullum escapes
a 121 kph low full toss, he almost hits it back to Malinga, falls short
full at 135 kph now, knocked back to the bowler
another slower one, he leans forward and pushes it to extra cover
guides a slower length ball to point
full around off, pushed back
full outside off, reverse swept to short third man
not too short, McCullum reacts at the last instant but his bat speed is so fast, he hammers this over deep midwicket
leaves the crease to work it off the pad to short fine
opens the face and runs this through third man for a couple
angled full and way down the leg side even as du Plessis makes some room
walks out to a tossed up wide one to push it to long off
slaps this flatter one off the back foot, Anderson throws himself to his left at extra cover
punches off the back foot to extra cover
comes out to turn it to vacant midwicket for a single
leading edge to extra cover as he pushes forward trying to work it to leg
runs a tossed up ball to point
turned past midwicket's slide for a single
flighted full on the stumps, he tried to nudge it to leg, ended up playing it back
Raina keeps coming out, Harbhajan pushes this straight and on a length outside off, Raina misses it and is stumped by miles
Raina comes out to a tossed up full ball and converts it into a yorker, digs it out

McCullum has made up his mind about the reverse sweep, Harbhajan flights this full towards leg, McCullum still plays the shot, it rolls to short third man, and he has to abandon his attempt at a single
skips out and pushes it back to the bowler
punches this bouncing length ball to sweeper cover off the back foot
nudged off the pad to fine leg
jumps across to work this length ball to vacant midwicket
Smith's holed out this time, he looked to slog another wide ball, the mishit swirled over cover, Anderson ran in a long way from the sweeper position, and slid forward to take it
another over begins with a six, Smith fetches this full one from outside off and slogs it over deep midwicket
length outside off and McCullum turns sweeper cover into a spectator again with his incredible bat speed
dropped, nearly got him there, McCullum hammered this widish length ball in the air, Pollard leaped to his right at mid off, stretching to get one hand to the ball but it was travelling too fast
cracked through the covers again, Anderson bowls a good length ball just outside off, there is a sweeper but McCullum has just too much power
charges out, Anderson bowls it much wider out of McCullum's reach
that went through, full and moving in just a bit, McCullum heaves outside the line and is beaten, the ball goes in the small gap between bat and the stumps
McCullum cracks the first ball - a slow and wide length ball - from his young New Zealand allrounder flat over extra cover
McCullum misses out again, this was a full toss angled in, he tries to work it past short fine leg again, but cannot time it well enough beat the man
leans forward to defend a pitched up ball, 119 kph, down the track
squeezes an overpitched ball outside off to the bowler
adjusts to dab this slower good length ball to backward point
slower one down the pad, McCullum tries to nudge it fine, but it runs weakly to short fine leg
slung full and down the leg side at 137 kph
a length ball moving in a tad to leg, nudged square
now the pull, this wasn't too short, but McCullum was so quick to swivel and launch it over midwicket
shot, McCullum has blitzed this length ball on the up, splitting the gap between extra cover and mid off
shorter and he cuts it quickly past backward point, sweeper gets to it
flat-bats a back of a length ball to mid off, not enough room
works a back of a length ball to midwicket
Zaheer overpitches early in the over and is slammed into the sightscreen with a powerful swipe from Smith
works this off the pad to deep midwicket
goes back on a length ball to punch to extra cover
quick and wide outside off, Smith reaches for it and slogs it straight and flat, no chance for long on again
appeal for leg before as he misses a sweep, umpire Erasmus shakes his head, could have been high
straightens from a good length on off and is guided towards point
there is long on but Smith has carted this overpitched delivery way over him
shortish now and he tries to pull but it falls onto the pitch and they take the single
fuller on middle and leg, he plays it back to the bowler
nice, has him prodding close to off with a 126 kph cutter that leaves the right hander to beat him
good length and just outside off stump, pushed to extra cover
this was a length ball down the pad, but McCullum has found short fine leg
136.1 kph from Zaheer first up, moving in a tad from outside off, pushed away from the crease
a maiden to start off from Ojha, this one comes straight on and is tapped to cover, Smith is not getting the single
quicker on a length now, pushed to extra cover
very full outside off at 85 kph, he mistimes a drive to mid off
straightens on middle, he pushes forward to defend to extra cover
pushed back to the bowler
angled full down the pad, and pops up on the off side as he misses it
